newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Health seeking new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Health seeking new CFO.

text.p: Advanced Health Corp said Thursday a search is underway for a new chief financial officer.
Effective September 15, the company explained, its current chief financial officer, Alan Masarek, will be promoted to president, succeeding co-founder Steven Hochberg.

Masarek will retain his position of chief operating officer, the company said, adding that this promotion will allow him to take an even more integral role in the company's future evolution and growth.
Also effective September 15, Hochberg will be promoted to vice chairman. As vice chairman, he will focus full-time on corporate business development and corporate transaction opportunities.
Advanced Health Corp provides integrated management services and clinical information systems to physician group practices and physician networks.
